article.body:
“וְעַל הַנִּסִים” to say, important things to get done;

Four mitzvos today that we hear, give, and ___________.

With family and friends, we enjoy a grand ____________.

On Purim our happiness breaks right through the day.

(Though each Yom Tov’s special and joyful, that’s right.)

Because today’s nes is limitless simcha and ____________!

Answers: eat, megillah, need, feast, celebrations, light
